messages:
jordan: Drafting a short changelog entry for the micro-release (routing flags + small SDK tweaks). Pulled together quick bullets in the PR. Need 1) tiny python + ts snippet update, 2) verify deprecation note for the old .route param, 3) callout for the known embed-ordering quirk. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/509

priya: thanks — will do code samples. want them as single-line examples or multi-line with imports?

jordan: single-line is fine for changelog; full snippets in examples page. For changelog keep it compact so marketing can fit it in the email. Example: `client.generate('summary', routing_policy='balanced')`

lin: i'm checking the SDK change. .route is deprecated in favor of routing_policy, will add a deprecation note in the SDK section and link to migration guide. ETA: later today.

deploy-bot: preview for PR 509: https://preview.redwood.dev/509 (expires 48h) :white_check_mark:

docs-lead: also add a one-line Known issues bullet: "Embedding order may change under specific batching; see migration steps." Keep it short.

priya: pushing one-line python + ts samples now.

lin: added deprecation blurb and crosslink to migration guide. left a note for support to update canned responses.

jordan: great — i'll merge once previews are green and ping marketing for the weekly digest.
